name: Kelaiah
overview: Kelaiah, also known as Kelita, was a Levite who played a significant role in the post-exilic community by helping to teach and explain God's law to the people, as seen in Nehemiah 8:7. He is listed among the Levites who took a decisive step to maintain covenant purity by divorcing their Gentile wives after the captivity, demonstrating obedience to God's commands and a commitment to holiness (Ezra 10:23; Nehemiah 10:10). His involvement highlights the Levites' responsibility in guiding Israel back to faithful adherence to God's covenant.
